Activity guides

Market Shopping in Jaisalmer

Wander the old-city bazaars and the lanes around Gandhi Chowk for souvenirs, gifts and everyday local life.

Explore this activity ↗

What to expect

  • Lively bazaar lanes
  • Souvenirs and gifts
  • Browsing and bargaining

Where and when

Gandhi Chowk and old-city bazaars.

Late afternoon, when it is cooler.

Before you go

Allow time to look at more than one shop. For delicate purchases, ask how the piece was made and how to pack it for your journey home.

Plan the rest of your visit

  • Jaisalmer Fort
  • Patwon Ki Haveli
